Reduce the file size of a PDF

Choose how hard to compress, see the new size before you download, and keep the original if the result is not smaller. Your file is processed in this tab and never uploaded.

How to compress a PDF

  1. Choose the PDF you want to make smaller.
  2. Pick a level: Basic, Recommended or Strong.
  3. Select Compress, check the new size, then download.

How your files are handled

Your files are opened, changed and saved by this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded, and the original file on your device is never modified. Closing the tab discards everything, so download your result first.

Questions

Are my files uploaded?
No. Everything runs in your browser with PDF.js and pdf-lib. Your documents are never sent to a server.
What do the levels do?
Basic rewrites the file without changing any content. Recommended also recompresses large JPEG photos and keeps text selectable. Strong turns every page into an image, which shrinks scans the most but removes selectable text.
Why is my PDF not much smaller?
Files that are mostly text, or whose images are already compressed, have little left to remove. In that case keep the original; the tool tells you when the result is not smaller.
Is it free?
Yes. There is no account, no watermark, no daily limit and no paid tier.
